boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Oregon
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Eugene food stops with published late hours, ranging from campus-adjacent sweets and calzones to all-night diners and drive-thrus.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: 632 E 13th Ave · near campus
cards.notes: Check the store page before leaving, then use the published late delivery window for cookies, brownies, or ice cream near the UO edge.
cards.short_summary: A campus-edge bakery with a published daily delivery window through 3 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies’ Eugene store page states that warm cookies are delivered until 3 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official store page states delivery is available until 3 AM daily; confirm ordering availability before travel.

cards.title: The Dough Co.
cards.subtitle: 1337 Hilyard St · near campus
cards.notes: Use the ordering page to confirm availability, then plan a pickup or delivery of a calzone, pizza, or other listed Italian fare.
cards.short_summary: A Hilyard Street calzone and pizza stop with hours listed to 3 AM daily.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dough Co.’s official Eugene page lists daily hours of 11 AM–3 AM at 1337 Hilyard Street.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 11 AM–3 AM daily. Check online ordering or call ahead for current service availability.

cards.title: Bellizzi's Pizza Joint
cards.subtitle: 1600 Coburg Rd #2 · Eugene
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s posted hours and order page for a late pizza, pasta, or sandwich pickup; the location also lists UO Campus delivery service.
cards.short_summary: A Coburg Road pizza shop whose official hours extend into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Bellizzi’s Eugene page lists Monday–Thursday hours until 2:30 AM and Friday–Saturday hours until 3:30 AM.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Mon–Thu 11 AM–2:30 AM; Fri–Sat 11 AM–3:30 AM; closed Sunday. Verify before travel.

cards.title: Track Town Pizza
cards.subtitle: 1809 Franklin Blvd · across from Matthew Knight Arena
cards.notes: Check the published schedule before heading over, then use the Franklin Boulevard location for pizza near the arena and university.
cards.short_summary: A pizza restaurant across from Matthew Knight Arena with midnight and 1 AM closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Travel Lane County lists Track Town Pizza at 1809 Franklin Blvd, open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Track Town Pizza | Eugene, Cascades & Coast
cards.access_notes: Published hours are Sun–Thu 11 AM–midnight and Fri–Sat 11 AM–1 AM. Confirm hours on the day of visit.

cards.title: Denny's on Glenwood Drive
cards.subtitle: 3652 Glenwood Dr · Eugene
cards.notes: Use the official locator for a round-the-clock meal option, and check the location page for its current dine-in, takeout, and service details.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner location for any-time breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official location page identifies the 3652 Glenwood Dr restaurant as open 24 hours and lists round-the-clock breakfast.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours every day; check the page for temporary service changes.

cards.title: Carl's Jr. on Coburg Road
cards.subtitle: 296 Coburg Rd · Eugene
cards.notes: Use the location page to confirm midnight closing, then choose dine-in, drive-thru, or the listed delivery options as available.
cards.short_summary: A Coburg Road fast-food stop with published midnight hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Carl’s Jr.’s official locator lists the 296 Coburg Road restaurant open 6 AM–12 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 6 AM–midnight daily. The location page lists drive-thru and delivery; verify current availability.

cards.title: Voodoo Doughnut Eugene
cards.subtitle: 20 E Broadway · downtown Eugene
cards.notes: Check the official location listing, then make this a Friday or Saturday doughnut stop when the published schedule runs through midnight.
cards.short_summary: A downtown doughnut shop with a published midnight Friday and Saturday close.
cards.evidence_claim: Voodoo Doughnut lists its Eugene shop at 20 E Broadway with Friday–Saturday hours of 7 AM–12 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official listing: Sun–Thu 7 AM–10 PM; Fri–Sat 7 AM–12 AM. Confirm holiday or event-night changes before going.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Division Avenue
cards.subtitle: 215 Division Ave · Eugene
cards.notes: Use the official locator for late drive-thru timing and its posted dine-in schedule, then confirm the service mode you need before departure.
cards.short_summary: A Eugene Taco Bell with drive-thru hours published to 4 AM most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists 215 Division Avenue drive-thru hours until 4 AM Sunday–Thursday and 24-hour service Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is posted until 4 AM Sun–Thu and 24 hours Fri–Sat; the page separately lists dine-in hours. Verify before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West 11th
cards.subtitle: 2890 West 11th Ave · Eugene
cards.notes: Treat this as a late drive-thru option: check the official schedule, then use the separately published dine-in hours if you plan to go inside.
cards.short_summary: A West 11th Avenue Taco Bell with drive-thru service published through the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its 2890 West 11th Ave drive-thru open until 4 AM most days, 5:30 AM Thursday, and 24 hours Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours run to 4 AM most days, 5:30 AM Thursday, and 24 hours Fri–Sat; dine-in hours differ. Verify first.

cards.title: Papa's Pizza on Coburg Road
cards.subtitle: 1577 Coburg Rd · Eugene
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s location page and use the listed 11 PM close for a late pizza meal; allow time for ordering before close.
cards.short_summary: A Coburg Road pizza parlor with official daily hours through 11 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa’s Pizza lists its 1577 Coburg Road Eugene location as open 11 AM–11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 11 AM–11 PM for the 1577 Coburg Rd location. Confirm kitchen and pickup timing before leaving.
